RemediationStrings.Title: SentinelOne must be installed
RemediationStrings.Description: This device does not appear to have the SentinelOne agent installed. Install or repair the approved SentinelOne Windows agent, then sync the device with Intune.

RemediationStrings.Title: SentinelOne service must be running
RemediationStrings.Description: The SentinelOne agent appears to be installed, but its service is not running. Restart the device or repair the SentinelOne agent, then sync with Intune.
